messages:
maria-partnerships: Heads-up: NimbusEdge (HW SI) wants Azure Gov + GCP marketplace listings. They asked what security artifacts we need (SOC2 summary, pen-test, firmware attestation) and whether we can accept presigned uploads. Target launch in ~6 weeks.

sam-security: I can own SOC2 and pen-test intake. Need pen scope doc, CVSS export for high findings, and remediation evidence. If tests >12 months old require retest or compensating controls.

jon-eng: They use on-device HSM for firmware signing. We need HSM vendor attestation, key fingerprint, serials, and signed firmware manifests (hash chain). Confirm whether pen testers had ability to extract bootloader.

lee-ops: Presign S3 is fine. Use s3://marketplace-uploads/presign-2024. Default retention 30d, can extend to 90d for reviewers. Will issue presign with 7d expiry and ACLs.

upload-bot: Intake checklist created: MKP-4291 - SOC2 (sam-security), Pen-test (sam-security), Firmware attestation (jon-eng), Redaction guide (tara-sis), Presign link (lee-ops).

tara-sis: I'll provide a redaction template. Ask them to remove PII and replace with <REDACTED_REASON> and include a redaction log mapping filenames to redactions.

maria-partnerships: Owners/deadlines: sam-security - ingest SOC/pen by EOD Friday (1758090000); jon-eng - firmware artifacts by next Tue (1758240000); lee-ops - presign link today; tara-sis - redaction template by Mon. I'll send partner instructions with presign command and manifest schema.

sam-security: Note: prefer auditor attestations where available; partner signed attestation acceptable for limited-assurance items. Will flag any limited items in intake.

jon-eng: If HSM attestation required, request vendor PDF + signing key fingerprint. We'll run verification once received.

lee-ops: Presign example to send:
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-uploads/presign-2024/nimbusedge-artifacts.zip --expires-in 604800
Include checksum header: sha256:<hex> and manifest.json with file-level checksums.

maria-partnerships: Draft to partner: "Hi NimbusEdge, please upload a single zip to the presign link with SOC2 summary, pen-test bundle (scope/report/evidence), firmware attestation + signed manifest, and manifest.json with checksums. Include witness avail if needed."

tara-sis: Posting redaction template after this thread.

lee-ops: Presign DM'd and ACLs set. Expiry 7 days.

maria-partnerships: Thanks team. If anything blocks ingestion mark P0 and loop in legal/security. Will follow up with partner. :pray:
